AICleaner is a storage management and file organization tool designed to help users better understand how space is used on their Android devices.

Over time, daily app usage can result in duplicate files, large media content, cached data, and temporary files that occupy valuable storage space. AICleaner provides a clear overview of storage usage and offers practical tools to help users review files and decide what to keep or remove based on their own needs.

Storage Overview and Analysis

AICleaner displays storage usage in a structured and easy-to-read format. Users can see how space is distributed across different file categories such as photos, videos, large files, and other content. This helps users quickly identify which types of files occupy the most storage on their device.

Duplicate File Review

The app assists users in identifying duplicate files stored locally on their device. Similar files are grouped together so users can review multiple copies and decide whether certain duplicates are no longer necessary. No files are deleted automatically, and all actions require clear user confirmation.

Local File Management

AICleaner allows users to browse and manage files directly on their device. Users can review photos, videos, and large files and choose which items to keep or remove. All file analysis and management actions are performed locally on the device.

Simple and Accessible Interface

The app is designed with a clean and straightforward interface. Clear navigation and labels help users manage storage efficiently without complicated steps or advanced technical knowledge.

Lightweight and Efficient Design

AICleaner is designed to operate efficiently without unnecessary background processes. The app focuses on essential storage-related features and avoids continuous background activity that could interfere with normal device usage.

Privacy and Transparency

AICleaner respects user privacy by performing file analysis and management locally. Personal files are not uploaded, stored, or processed on external servers. Users remain in full control of their data at all times.

Advertising and Analytics

To support ongoing development, AICleaner may display advertisements and use analytics tools to understand usage patterns, improve stability, and enhance functionality. Collected data is limited to device and usage information and is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

User Expectations

AICleaner is intended as a storage organization and file review utility. The app does not claim to increase system performance, device speed, RAM capacity, or battery life. Actual results depend on user actions and storage conditions.

Permissions

The app requests only the permissions necessary to access and analyze files stored locally on the device. These permissions are used solely to enable storage analysis and file review features.

Support

If you have questions, feedback, or need assistance, please contact us using the support email listed on the Google Play store page.

AICleaner aims to provide a transparent and responsible way to manage storage, helping users make informed decisions about their device content.

Distance Meter is a complete measurement toolkit with AR distance measuring and 9 professional tools — all in one app. Powered by Google ARCore, the app detects your device\'s hardware and selects the best measurement engine for maximum accuracy.

Whether you\'re leveling a shelf, measuring room dimensions, or checking angles, Distance Meter has the right tool for every job.

[9 Measurement Tools]

Distance Meter goes far beyond a simple ruler. It includes 9 specialized tools:

• Bubble Level — Circular spirit level with realistic 3D liquid and bubble animation. Check if surfaces are perfectly horizontal.

• Clinometer — Slope and angle gauge measuring 0° to 90°. Ideal for roofs, ramps, and terrain slopes.

• Plumb Bob — Digital plumb bob with gravity-based pendulum. Verify perfect vertical alignment.

• Protractor — Touch and sensor-based angle measurement from 0° to 180°. Measure angles between objects or surfaces.

• Screen Ruler — On-screen ruler in centimeters and inches. Measure small objects directly on your phone screen.

• Frame Checker — Camera-based frame alignment tool. Check if picture frames, TVs, and shelves are perfectly level.

• Height Meter — AR-powered height measurement. Measure the height of people, furniture, doors, and buildings.

• Width & Height — AR dimension measurement. Get both width and height of objects in a single session.

• Area Calculator — AR multi-point area calculation. Mark corners to calculate floor area, wall space, or any surface.

[Smart Measurement Engine — 4-Tier System]

Your device is automatically matched to the best available engine:

• Premium (ToF/LiDAR) — Hardware depth sensors deliver ±2cm accuracy. Ideal for construction and precise work.

• High (Depth API) — Software depth estimation with ±5cm precision. Available on most modern devices.

• Standard (ARCore) — Surface detection and feature tracking with ±10cm accuracy.

• Basic (Camera) — Camera-based estimation for devices without AR support.

[How to Measure]

1. Tap the Measure button or select a tool

2. Point your camera at the target

3. Wait for the green indicator (optimal conditions)

4. Align the crosshair and tap to measure

5. Results display instantly with estimated accuracy (±cm)

[Real-Time Accuracy Feedback]

Distance Meter monitors 5 conditions in real time:

• Tracking status — Is ARCore actively tracking?

• Lighting — Is the scene well-lit?

• Surface detection — Has a surface been found?

• Feature points — Are enough visual features visible?

• Camera stability — Is the device steady?

[Multi-Strategy Fusion Technology]

This AR ruler combines results from multiple measurement strategies (Depth, Plane, Point Cloud) using confidence-weighted fusion, eliminating outliers and improving accuracy by up to 30%.

[Key Features]

• 9 measurement tools in one app

• 4-tier AR engine (ToF/LiDAR → Depth API → ARCore → Basic)

• 6 units: meters, centimeters, feet, inches, yards, millimeters

• Auto-save measurements to history

• Sound and vibration feedback

• Grid overlay and level indicators

• Dark and light mode support

• Status bar shortcut for quick access

[Tips for Best Results]

• Ensure good lighting (avoid very dark or very bright conditions)

• Move your device slowly during initialization

• Keep a steady hand — stability directly affects accuracy

• Measure textured surfaces (avoid mirrors, glass, solid white walls)

• Optimal AR range: 0.5m to 5m

Your feedback helps us improve. Please leave a review!

[Disclaimer]

Measurement results are estimates based on AR technology and device sensors. Actual distances may vary depending on device, environment, and conditions. This app is not intended for professional surveying or safety-critical applications.

PAIOS - Personal AI Operating System

A 100% offline, private, and powerful interface for AICore (and maybe something else!).

Changelog

You can find the full changelog here: https://github.com/Puzzaks/PAIOS/CHANGELOG.md

Roadmap

You can see what is planned for this project here: https://github.com/Puzzaks/PAIOS/ROADMAP.md

Features

• 100% Offline & Private

• Full Model Control

• Multiple chats!

• Custom Instructions

• Context-Aware

• Total Transparency

• A (Strong) Personality

• 100% Offline & Private

This app leverages local AI API. This means that your prompts and conversations should never leave your phone.

The model this app uses runs entirely on-device using Google's AI Core. Your prompts are

processed locally, and no data is ever sent to a server. What you ask the model stays between you and your phone.

• Full Model Control

You have full control over the model. Of course you cannot edit the System Prompt, but trust me, you don't want to play with it anyway. You can augment it by adding User Instructions that will be incorporated. You can also control the main parameters of the model:

Temperature: Control the creativity vs. coherence of the AI (0.0 = robotic, 1.0 = chaotic).

Max Response Tokens: Decide how much you want the AI to generate, from a short sentence to a longer paragraph.

The AI usually generates less than 75% of the requested context size. This happens because not every token is used, but each one is counted.

• Multiple chats!

You now have ability to have multiple chats, each with own context. The global settings apply to each of them, but you can rename, pin, delete them at your will. The AI also can help you choose the name for the conversation!

• Custom Instructions

You can use [USER INSTRUCTIONS] to steer the AI to do what you want. You can create custom personalities, set specific rules ("always answer in pirate"), or tailor the AI's behavior for your specific tasks.

• Context-Awareness

Should you enable this function, the app will inject the current time/date and app language into the prompt, giving the model real-time awareness for more relevant answers.

This is a proof of concept, if it works well there will be more integrations.

• Total Transparency

Unlike most AI apps, there are no hidden tricks. You can literally read the System Prompt used in the app from the settings. (https://github.com/Puzzaks/PAIOS/assets/system_prompt.txt) You see exactly what the model sees.

• A (Strong) Personality

Even though the model has it's own unchangeable prompt, a lot of time was spent on fixing model behavior. This does not work 100% times, but if you try to use the app without the prompt, you'll see that you are speaking with an older AI model.
